lesson.child_mission: Fluency practice mixes counting, partitioning and comparing so place-value skills stay connected under mild time pressure without rushing sense-making.

lesson.guided_practice:
PRACTISE BEFORE READING THE FEEDBACK
Complete: partition 2,905; compare with 2,950; count back by hundreds from 2,905 three times.

FEEDBACK
2,905=2,000+900+5; 2,905<2,950; 2,805; 2,705; 2,605.

WATCH FOR
Speed that drops reasons is not fluency; accuracy with reasons comes first.
lesson.independent_task:
INDEPENDENT EVIDENCE
Complete a mixed fluency sheet of nine items (3 count, 3 partition, 3 compare) with numbers you have not used today. Self-mark with place reasons.

Write a short reflection naming one step you corrected and why.

lesson.parent_notes:
Parent: Marking guidance for the independent task: Complete a mixed fluency sheet of nine items (3 count, 3 partition, 3 compare) with numbers you have not used today. Self-mark with place reasons. Accept equivalent original responses that show the same skill.

Parent: Written model 1: Original response on new material: 2,905=2,000+900+5; 2,905<2,950; 2,805; 2,705; 2,605. Reasoning: I used fluency by attending to count and explain why it matters rather than copying the worked model.

Parent: Written model 2: Common error: Speed that drops reasons is not fluency; accuracy with reasons comes first. Correction: 2,905=2,000+900+5; 2,905<2,950; 2,805; 2,705; 2,605. Why: the correction restores accurate use of fluency.

Parent: Likely misconception: Speed that drops reasons is not fluency; accuracy with reasons comes first. Keep sample answers out of the child role.

Parent: Short-answer focus 1: Solve one fresh problem that uses fluency with different numbers from the worked model. Show working and name the places or values that matter.

Parent: Short-answer focus 2: Describe one likely mistake with fluency, show corrected working, and say why the correction works.

Parent: Marking notes: Require new numbers, visible working and named places/values. / Require a real misconception, corrected working and a method reason..

teach_steps.example:
WORKED MODEL
Set: partition 4,080; compare 4,080 and 4,800; count on by tens from 4,080 five times → 4,090; 4,100; 4,110; 4,120; 4,130.

TRY FIRST
Complete: partition 2,905; compare with 2,950; count back by hundreds from 2,905 three times.

FEEDBACK
2,905=2,000+900+5; 2,905<2,950; 2,805; 2,705; 2,605.
teach_steps.explain:
Fluency practice mixes counting, partitioning and comparing so place-value skills stay connected under mild time pressure without rushing sense-making.

WHY IT MATTERS
This helps the learner choose methods based on place value, quantity and accurate working, rather than guessing digits by shape alone. Keep every step justified.

HOW TO WORK
Read the worked example and name the places, values or distances that carry the method. Before looking at the correction, make your own attempt using the exact question provided. Compare your working with the feedback: did you use the same skill and show your reasoning? If a digit or place is uncertain, identify what would have to be regrouped or counted again. One deliberate, justified revision is more useful than writing a longer answer.
teach_steps.notice: Speed that drops reasons is not fluency; accuracy with reasons comes first. Correct the value or method, not just the appearance of the digits.
